name: Xiangling
title: Exquisite Delicacy
description: A renowned chef from Liyue. She's extremely passionate about cooking and excels at making her signature hot and spicy dishes.

skills.name: Dough-Fu
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Guoba Attack
skills.description: Summons Guoba, who will continuously breathe fire at opponents, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.
skills.info: Guoba loves to eat spicy food. Problem is, his stomach can't handle something this spicy.

skills.name: Pyronado
skills.description:
Displaying her mastery over both fire and polearms, Xiangling sends a Pyronado whirling around her.
The Pyronado will move with your character for the ability's duration, dealing Pyro DMG to all opponents in its path.
skills.info: There will never be enough heat. Never.

passives.name: Crossfire
passives.description: Increases the flame range of Guoba by 20%.

passives.name: Beware, It's Super Hot!
passives.description: When Guoba Attack's effect ends, Guoba leaves a chili pepper on the spot where it disappeared. Picking up a chili pepper increases ATK by 10% for 10s.

passives.name: Chef de Cuisine
passives.description: When Xiangling cooks an ATK-boosting dish perfectly, she has a 12% chance to receive double the product.

constellations.name: Crispy Outside, Tender Inside
constellations.description: Opponents hit by Guoba's attacks have their Pyro RES reduced by 15% for 6s.

constellations.name: Oil Meets Fire
constellations.description: The last attack in a Normal Attack sequence applies the Implode status onto the opponent for 2s. An explosion will occur once this duration ends, dealing 75% of Xiangling's ATK as AoE Pyro DMG.

constellations.name: Deepfry
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Pyronado by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Guoba Mad
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Guoba Attack by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Condensed Pyronado
constellations.description: For the duration of Pyronado, all party members receive a 15% Pyro DMG Bonus.

outfits.name: New Year's Cheer
outfits.description: Xiangling's outfit. The red coat glows like a stove amidst cold winds, topped with a hat that, at Hu Tao's suggestion, took inspiration from Guoba's appearance — a design that's right up Xiangling's alley.

outfits.name: Red Pepper and Turmeric
outfits.description: Xiangling's outfit. Light and comfortable clothing brimming with fiery passion.

voices.title: Hello
voices.text: Hello, nice to meet you! My name is Xiangling, I'm a chef from Liyue! My favorite place is the chicken... I mean, the kitchen! Ugh, I practiced so hard, but I still get nervous when introducing myself... Heh.

voices.title: Chat: Snacks
voices.text: Is there time for a quick snack? I'll whip one up in no time!

voices.title: Chat: Pyro Slime
voices.text: I can't decide whether Pyro slimes taste better with salt and pepper or garlic and herbs...

voices.title: Chat: Looking for Food
voices.text: If there's nothing better to do, we could go foraging for ingredients...

voices.title: When It Rains: Attitude
voices.text: Oh... I don't like the rain.

voices.title: When It Rains: Negligence
voices.text: Wait... did I leave my apron outside to dry?

voices.title: After the Rain
voices.text: The rain has stopped! Come with me, let's pick some matsutake.

voices.title: When It's Windy
voices.text: Anemo Slimes always come out in this weather. If you catch some, I'll make you a Slime Slushie!

voices.title: Good Morning
voices.text: Perfect timing! Wanna get a few cooking supplies?

voices.title: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Lunch is ready! Come and get it while it lasts! *munching*

voices.title: Good Evening
voices.text: You're just in time for a midnight snack! I made some barbecued lizard skewers. Well, don't just stand there — dig in!

voices.title: Good Night
voices.text: Hey! You're not sneaking off to get a midnight snack without me, are you? ...Bedtime? Oh. Well, good night then!

voices.title: About Xiangling
voices.text: You've seen the dragon in Mondstadt? How big was it? What!? No way! Imagine how big a steak a dragon that huge would make!

voices.title: About Us: Strengths
voices.text: I'm much better at cooking than navigating... but if you do go out, definitely take me with you!

voices.title: About Us: New Knowledge
voices.text: Meeting you has really opened my eyes to things other than cooking. Like what? Well, such as... um... for example... I can't think when you put me on the spot! Forget it, I'll stick to cooking from now on. I have a new recipe for you to try, actually...

voices.title: About the Vision
voices.text: Any time, night or day, I am always willing to make dishes everyone loves. I think the Archons agree with my passion, or else they wouldn't have given me this Vision, something even my master doesn't have... I know they want me to keep going!

voices.title: Something to Share
voices.text: If you get a stomach ache, a cup of herbal tea with Silk Flowers will clear it up in no time! Huh? Of course you can trust my herbal remedies! We chefs are expected to know a thing or two about medicine as well, you know!

voices.title: Interesting Things
voices.text: I love onions! I've tried cutting them dozens of ways, and they still make me cry... No matter, I still love them!

voices.title: About Baizhu
voices.text: I can smell Mist Grass! It must be Dr. Baizhu! What is he doing here? *Shocked* Are you OK? Do you feel faint? Is your stomach sore? Or is it a sore throat? I've got it, you're fatigued from all that adventuring! No?... You're fine? Phew! Otherwise, he would've made you drink some traditional herbal medicine — it's so bitter!

voices.title: About Ningguang
voices.text: That was the Tianquan! Did you see? She just walked past. Come here... closer... Let me tell you, she knows everything that happens in Liyue, so... keep a low profile, don't attract her attention!

voices.title: About Hu Tao
voices.text: Is Hu Tao picking on you too? Ugh, that prankster always waits till I least expect it, creeps up on me from behind and then... Boo! ...then laughs herself silly. Hmph. But I can handle it, and she does bring me fermented plum blossoms once in a while so I can make flower cakes... so I don't hold a grudge.

voices.title: About Diona
voices.text: Diona, from Springvale! Ah, I heard she mixes a great drink, so I came specifically to see her! I thought perhaps I could use her secrets in my cooking, and bring out more flavors. But the tips that she gave me — like soaking lizard tails in beer, or putting bits of smoked fish in dandelion wine — all came out really awful. *sigh* Guess it's up to me to work it out myself, then.

voices.title: About Beidou
voices.text: Oh, Beidou is the greatest! Every time I go out sailing with her, she always manages to fish up lots of fresh ingredients! Octopus tentacles go great in soup, and seaweed fries up great with some chilis. Not just Beidou, but everyone on board The Crux loves my cooking.

voices.title: About Zhongli
voices.text: I've come across a lot of fussy eaters, but Mr. Zhongli is very particular and has no problem getting straight to what he has to say. The first time I served him salt and pepper tofu, he took just one bite, and then proceeded to say: "It would be better to try sea salt extracted from the shallow seas of Guyun Stone Forest, because it would bring a fresh sense of depth to the tofu." I tried it and the taste was just so different! He's just amazing, don't you think!?

voices.title: About Chongyun
voices.text: Chongyun? I always see him on his way to eat at Wanmin Restaurant with Xingqiu... Ah... or perhaps I should say I see him being dragged there by Xingqiu? Chongyun doesn't eat hot food. Every time the hot food arrives, Xingqiu politely apologizes and proceeds to try every dish. I just wanna dig in with him! The look on Chongyun's face is priceless. They're quite interesting, those two.

voices.title: About Ganyu
voices.text: Ganyu? Oh... Oh yeah! I remember her — vegetarian, right? She doesn't come to the Wanmin Restaurant very often — but when she does, she sits alone in the corner and eats her meal in total silence. Poor girl, she seems kinda lonely... I always give her an extra-large portion because I feel sorry for her. Funniest thing is, she eats every last bite, every time! I wouldn't have guessed she had such an appetite just by looking at her.

voices.title: About Yaoyao
voices.text: Hee-hee, I'm proud to call her my junior! She hasn't swung by the Wanmin Restaurant in ages, though. Maybe master is trying to protect her from me or something... Last time we hung out, I was about to dig into some fresh raw octopus from the Sea of Clouds, but not only did she stop me from eating it, she sent master to tell me off too! Ugh... Honestly, sometimes it feels like I'm the one who gets treated like the junior...

voices.title: About Xinyan
voices.text: Xinyan always comes to the Wanmin Restaurant for a late-night snack! She gobbles up all the new dishes that the likes of Xingqiu and Chongyun don't go near... and nine times out of ten, she enjoys them too! She's great.

voices.title: About Yelan
voices.text: Yelan? Of course, I remember her! When I first met her, I was certain she'd be the kind of gal who'd prefer lighter dishes... turned out that she can handle the most spice out of all my customers! Apparently, my dishes weren't spicy enough for her, because she started taking bites of raw Jueyun Chilis! Truly amazing.

voices.title: About Gaming
voices.text: Oh boy, once I know Gaming is coming, I make sure to prepare a huge pot of tea in advance. You know, so he can wash some of the spicy food down. I've offered to tone down the spice a bit for him, but he absolutely insists that he prefers the authentic flavor... And he's not even just saying that to be polite. Believe me, I know a true foodie when I see one! Anyway, if that's what he prefers, then who am I to disappoint, hehe!

voices.title: About Lan Yan
voices.text: Guoba loves Lan Yan! They spent soooooo long shaking hands when they first met, it was like they'd known each other forever, haha. Lan Yan actually promised to take me foraging for wild mushrooms and insects... Hehe, once my new dish is ready, you've gotta come try it!

voices.title: About Escoffier
voices.text: Oh! You mean that chef from Fontaine, right? She's great! I got to try a bunch of her new dishes the other day. They were all so... what's the word... precise! It was like she took all the flavors and ingredients in her dishes and transformed them into art! I was amazed at how meticulous everything was — every measurement, every technique executed to perfection! I kinda want Shenhe to ask Aunty Xianyun to make me a precision cooking machine of my own, so I can try out Escoffier's style of cooking!

voices.title: More About Xiangling: I
voices.text: Roasted pigeon skewers, anyone? C'mon, it's my secret recipe, you'll love it!

voices.title: More About Xiangling: II
voices.text: My master did a good job teaching me spear fighting, don't you think? If you want, I could teach you too. Although... I'd much rather teach you my cooking, if you're interested! I want my recipes to spread all around Teyvat!

voices.title: More About Xiangling: III
voices.text: My heart's desire? To start my very own cooking tradition, of course! Li-style and Yue-style cooking are good, but they have a limited palate. The missing ingredient? Chili pepper! Come, let me fry up one of Guoba's chili peppers for you...

voices.title: More About Xiangling: IV
voices.text: I think I've won you over with my cooking now, right? It's time to introduce you to my latest masterpiece — I call it the "most marvelous multi-colored super pancake"! Bright red squirrel ham, orange carrot, yellow sunfrog meat, green calla lily and blue butterfly wings, beautifully wrapped in a thin egg pancake— What? I thought you said you were starving! *sigh* Okay.

voices.title: More About Xiangling: V
voices.text: I'm in a dilemma and I don't know how to solve it... It isn't like me to get so worked up over nothing... Ah! Well, here's the thing. I always love getting you to try my latest recipes, but... I'm worried that my food might not agree with your stomach and... I can't bear the thought of that happening. What should I do?

voices.title: Xiangling's Hobbies
voices.text: Watch carefully! Heat the oil in a pan, then take a handful of crystalflies — wings removed — pop them in, and voila! Delicious deep-fried crystal— Hey! Where are you going?

voices.title: Xiangling's Troubles
voices.text: It's been a month and I still haven't sold a single bowl of Mushroom Slime Stew. Gee, is it just because it looks sticky and gooey? It's their loss if they don't have a spoonful...

voices.title: Favorite Food
voices.text: My favorite thing to eat is... whatever exotic ingredient I haven't tried yet! No, I'm not dodging the question, that's my honest answer!

voices.title: Least Favorite Food
voices.text: I'll eat absolutely anything! There are no bad ingredients, only bad cooking!

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: I
voices.text: Mmm... wow! I know this taste, it's... boom shaka-laka!

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: II
voices.text: I gotta admit, you're really good at cooking. Next time, it's my turn to show you a thing or two.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: III
voices.text: Are you sure you followed the recipe? Something is definitely off here...

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Ah, there you are! Come with me, I've prepared a birthday feast all for you! ... No really, I insist! Which dish is your favorite? It's okay, take your time, try them all first, then let me know!

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Intro
voices.text: Oh wow! This feels great! My whole body is bursting with energy!

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Building Up
voices.text: Hey! Ha! Hua! I can slay a beast with one punch, locking in that freshness!

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Climax
voices.text: Finally... with this power, I can cook... *giggle* ...Oh no, I've started salivating!

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Conclusion
voices.text: As my father always says: "To make a five-star dish, you need ten-star passion!" I know, I know! To be able to come this far is definitely thanks to your ten-star passion when it comes to practicing with me, so I'll be sure to pay you back with two— no, three times the passion!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: I
voices.text: Guoba, get them!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: II
voices.text: Nice and spicy!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: III
voices.text: Out of the frying pan, into the fire!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: I
voices.text: Hey... Yah!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: II
voices.text: You're toast!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: III
voices.text: Eat this!

voices.title: Sprint Start: I
voices.text: Race you!

voices.title: Sprint End: I
voices.text: Now I've got stomach cramps...

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: I
voices.text: Open sesame! Oh, now I'm hungry...

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: II
voices.text: What a bountiful harvest!

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: III
voices.text: None of this will go to waste!

voices.title: Low HP: I
voices.text: No ingredients for me today...

voices.title: Low HP: II
voices.text: Ow! Oh...

voices.title: Low HP: III
voices.text: Now I'm really in a pickle!

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: I
voices.text: Take a snack break!

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: II
voices.text: Scramble!

voices.title: Fallen: I
voices.text: Dinner's gonna burn...

voices.title: Fallen: II
voices.text: Water...

voices.title: Fallen: III
voices.text: No... Did I ruin everything?

voices.title: Light Hit Taken: I
voices.text: Don't hit me...

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: I
voices.text: Help! My dinner is attacking me!

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: II
voices.text: That really hurt!

voices.title: Joining Party: I
voices.text: I'll bring my seasonings!

voices.title: Joining Party: II
voices.text: Just sharpened my spear!

voices.title: Joining Party: III
voices.text: I can't wait any longer!
